scope: Public FreeConvert case and current official Google rules, not full competitor security/product execution test

records.claim: FreeConvert's About page states it launched in 2018 following experience with ImageResizer.com.
records.caveat: Do not infer exact traffic-growth curve or causality from company history.

records.claim: FreeConvert's About page claims over 3000 file conversion and compression tools; its homepage separately says over 1500 file conversions.
records.caveat: Different nouns/time/definitions. Do not assume either number equals indexed unique URLs.

records.claim: Public AhrefsTop November 2026 reports estimated 9.4M monthly Google organic visits and 87K ranking keywords.
records.caveat: Estimated organic Google visits, NOT all-channel sessions, not first-party GSC.

records.claim: Public AhrefsTop November 2026 reports DR 77 and approximately 7.4K linking websites.
records.caveat: DR is a proprietary backlink metric, not Google ranking weight; no backlink source quality audit performed.

records.claim: Public AhrefsTop November 2026 reports FreeConvert position #1 in US for video compressor, estimated ~48.8K monthly visits from that keyword.
records.caveat: One observed keyword/country/time snapshot, NOT universal ranking #1.

records.claim: Public AhrefsTop November 2026 reports FreeConvert US position #1 for gif compressor.
records.caveat: Dated estimates; current live SERP may vary by location/device/queries.

records.claim: Public AhrefsTop November 2026 reports FreeConvert US position #2 for mp4 to mp3.
records.caveat: This itself disproves an assertion that FreeConvert ranks first for every term.

records.claim: Homepage and tool navigation link individual format pairs, compression tools, PDF tools, developer APIs and related services.
records.caveat: Having numerous internal links does not alone establish that Google values or indexes them.

records.claim: Video-compressor page exposes file chooser, Dropbox/Drive/OneDrive/URL inputs, max 1GB notice, codecs, target size and presets.
records.caveat: UI/text documented; no actual file conversion success benchmark performed.

records.claim: MP4-to-MP3 page documents procedure, codec options, format explanations and many related conversion paths.
records.caveat: Large page/related links are not proof of separate unique usefulness or causal ranking lift.

records.claim: Pricing FAQ advertises 20 free conversion minutes per day and 5 minutes per individual file; upgrades support paid jobs.
records.caveat: Live account limits and changes must be rechecked; no plan-income data available.

records.claim: Public FreeConvert API v1 docs specify programmatic conversion/merge/optimization and advanced settings.
records.caveat: API presence suggests more than display-ad monetization, not actual paid conversion share.

records.claim: About page self-reports Nuxt/Vue frontend, Node/MongoDB backend, AWS/Azure and Playwright plus observability tools.
records.caveat: Self-described stack; not independently confirmed from infrastructure audit.

records.claim: Privacy policy says files are stored using AWS S3 in Ireland; MP4-to-MP3 page claims automatic deletion after 8 hours.
records.caveat: Privacy and retention claims not independently audited; do not imply browser-local processing or verified compliance.

records.claim: About content and site navigation are available at publicly indexed locale paths such as /ja/about and /de/about.
records.caveat: Localized content exists; hreflang implementation and organic contribution NOT inspected.

records.claim: Semrush/ExplodingTopics shows estimated 64.3M all-channel monthly visits in September 2026, unlike Ahrefs 9.4M Google organic in November.
records.caveat: Different period/metric/model; DO NOT sum, equate or call either actual GSC.

records.claim: Ahrefs public 2026 free-tool SEO strategy cites four FreeConvert tool URLs with estimated US organic traffic.
records.caveat: Snapshot estimates may differ from Nov 2026 and do not prove causal strategy.

records.claim: MP4-to-MP3 page has a CTA inviting an upgrade to avoid queues or ads.
records.caveat: Does not prove the AdSense program, active account status, network mix or ad earnings.

records.claim: Google official Search guidance says indexing/ranking is never guaranteed even when Search Essentials are met.
records.caveat: This is provider policy, not a ranking forecast.

records.claim: Google defines scaled content and doorway abuse; large near-duplicate format pages without useful functionality risk policy violations.
records.caveat: The policy does NOT declare FreeConvert in violation; risk applies to our implementation choices.

records.claim: Google says AdSense applicants need unique relevant content, clear navigation and a real user experience; site status reviewed by Google.
records.caveat: No guarantee of approval and no fact about FreeConvert's AdSense account.

records.claim: Google says Google AI Mode/Overviews supporting-link eligibility requires indexed pages eligible for a Search snippet and no additional technical requirements.
records.caveat: Eligibility is not citation appearance or a guaranteed human click.

records.claim: Google says llms.txt, artificial small chunks, AI-only markup and inauthentic mentions are not necessary Search visibility tactics.
records.caveat: Only Google's stated Search surface, not all independent LLM products.

records.claim: Connected Ahrefs Site Explorer metrics requests for FreeConvert and peers returned Insufficient plan.
records.caveat: Do not claim we retrieved fresh authenticated organic keyword exports, link index or referring domain lists.

hypotheses.mechanism: Task-specific high-intent page coverage increases search entry points
hypotheses.needed: Crawl/index inventory, canonical duplication audit, query->URL mapping, actual unique user job
hypotheses.counter: Indexed thin doorway pages can be ignored or penalized.

hypotheses.mechanism: Established backlink graph and brand improve visibility
hypotheses.needed: Refdomain quality/history, branded vs nonbranded estimates, temporal evidence
hypotheses.counter: High domain DR alone cannot explain each page or guarantee rank.

hypotheses.mechanism: Deep functional options improve user task success, which helps commercial outcomes
hypotheses.needed: Identical sample-file benchmark, failure rate, actual task completion, ad load
hypotheses.counter: Complex controls may hurt usability and speed for basic tasks.

hypotheses.mechanism: Cross-product network and API integrations generate distribution independent of SEO
hypotheses.needed: Referral logs, public integrations/case studies, actual acquisition reports
hypotheses.counter: API products may contribute revenue without sending search traffic.

hypotheses.needed: Hreflang, human translation quality, geo-level search traffic and user task fit
hypotheses.counter: Machine-translated duplicate localized pages may be low quality.

hypotheses.mechanism: Browser-local private processing creates viable competitive edge for certain tasks
hypotheses.needed: Competitor upload privacy observation, local WASM/browser correctness/cost performance, task willingness
hypotheses.counter: Heavy video/PDF conversions may require cloud compute and fail on low-memory phones.

hypotheses.mechanism: Free-to-paid model funds complex processing while ads monetize less intensive tasks
hypotheses.needed: Actual accounts, plans, unit-cost model, provider ad/premium revenue logs
hypotheses.counter: We have no access to FreeConvert's revenue mix or margins.

next: Form hypotheses into controlled competitive experiments, not SEO myths
